example.title: U.S. Post Office, Isanti, Minnesota
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (1 photo; date approximate from style)

brief: Low one-storey flat-roofed post office of dark red brick in a fast-growing exurban town: a long plain front with three square picture windows, a slim metal coping, a small 'United States Post Office' sign by the glass entrance at one end, a tall flagpole, a bench and bike rack on the sidewalk, and an older gabled house next door.
